title: parseAmount now returns cents but checkout still multiplies by 100

pr_metadata.title: parseAmount: return integer cents
pr_metadata.body: Float drift showed up in reports; cents are exact.

labels.defect: Unit change (dollars → cents) in a shared helper without updating the caller
labels.evidence: chargeCents('12.34') now returns 123400 instead of 1234 — a 100× overcharge; the only caller still multiplies by 100.

labels.defect: chargeCents double-scales the amount after the helper's unit change
labels.evidence: Math.round(parseAmount(input) * 100) with parseAmount already in cents.
